description: rfasst contains R functions for estimating air-pollution impacts of Global Change Analysis Model scenarios. JGCRI publishes the package to connect scenario emissions with a reduced-form representation of the TM5-FASST calculations. Its modules rescale GCAM-region emissions, estimate particulate-matter and ozone concentrations, and calculate associated health and agricultural effects. The geographic units follow the GCAM and TM5-FASST region mappings; the time period follows the supplied scenario, not a fixed observational series. GitHub hosts the package, documentation and R installation instructions. Repository metadata states BSD-2-Clause, permitting free reuse. Default R data files provide category mappings, allocation shares and impact coefficients, which users can replace. Limitations include dependence on reduced-form relationships and selected exposure-response or valuation assumptions. The package can help examine consequences of energy and land-use scenarios alongside infrastructure-planning models. Related record model-gcam-china is a regional GCAM model in the catalogue; this link denotes shared modelling context, not verified direct compatibility. The package and its bundled data were not downloaded or executed.
